podcast.body: Released in 1987, this album (spelled with silent Ps) followed their debut EP. Psonic Psunspot garnered significant positive attention, receiving great reviews and producing a single that achieved success on alternative radio in North America, indicating that the pseudonymous project gained traction and was widely appreciated. "then came Sonic Sunspots, both spelled with Silent Peas in 1987, and that second record actually gained some traction."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
